review_scope: All 118 portable-selected source file contents fetched and checked for exact Git blob identity. All 15 Python script sources statically screened for side-effect operations; high-risk installer, hooks, launch supervisor, scaffolding and benchmarking paths inspected. 28 references, 15 docs, 50 evaluation assets and 10 other files inspected for material instructions/rights and source identity. No external static security scanner used.

portable_package.reason_no_installed_tree_sha: Portable package assembled from a source root subset; no installer was run, no installed target exists.

rubric_rationale.trigger_precision: Specific ROS2 engineering triggers and explicit exclusions for unrelated C++/Python/web tasks. Router selects relevant references only.
rubric_rationale.procedural_clarity: Strong task-specific paths across ROS communication, hardware, firmware, safety, provenance, QoS, tests and deployment, plus explicit response/evidence shape.
rubric_rationale.authority_safety: Explicit separation of read-only review, approval, runtime readiness and operator-executed physical tests. Source contains active tools, so unchanged installation still requires an action-specific gate.
rubric_rationale.failure_handling: Installer refuses ordinary clobbering, checks symlinks, staged validation and rollback. Hook/eval contracts distinguish failures and skipped checks from actual passes; recovery still unexecuted here.
rubric_rationale.evidence_discipline: L0-L6 ladder, measured stop path, actual loaded configuration vs source files, positive diagnostic controls and transparent fixtures.
rubric_rationale.dependency_coherence: Portable bundle is 118 files with 15 Python scripts; ROS distro, PyYAML, client/runtime dependencies and optional plugin create substantial qualification surface.
rubric_rationale.portability_honesty: Clear distinction between portable hook-free copy, Claude plugin registration and full-checkout/legacy tools; version/platform limits are plainly stated.
rubric_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: Depth and specificity of hardware stop, artifact provenance, experimental captures and carefully scoped evidence make it valuable beyond a simple ROS command cheat sheet.
rubric_rationale.adversarial_resilience: Untrusted logs are explicitly data, hooks called advisory, but no independent attack/host acceptance and a wide executable/tool surface remain.
rubric_rationale.effectiveness_design: Meaningful structural/evaluation test design and historical source claims, but no independently executed security, setup, simulator or real-world evidence in this review.

user_value: Diagnose the ROS environment and loaded configuration before changing it; keep operator authority, engineering readiness and observed safety behavior distinct. Prefer bounded non-actuating tests with recorded evidence.
strengths: Selective 27-area router and detailed 28 reference files
Clear physical-test authorization and real operator execution separation
Strong artifact/provenance awareness and L0-L6 verification claims
Portable installer includes explicit file manifest/rollback and symlink/no-clobber gates
Evidence and documentation clearly distinguish structural fixture smoke tests from actual behavior

source_observations.evidence: BUNDLE tuple selects 118 files; staged copy, hash/provenance manifest, validation, target no-clobber by default, --force/--discard-local-changes explicit and backup restore on failed rename.
ROS package generation writes a destination; CLI refuses existing package unless explicit --force and rejects symlinks; --force can overwrite files in prior package.
Runs ROS launch processes after user invocation, not a static validator; cannot certify a real hardware stop.
Claude plugin can call fixed Python validators using bounded subprocess; advisory output and hooks are not a security boundary; installed source alone does not enable hooks.
Reads Git status and selected source or potentially walks a workspace if Git cannot establish changes; execution logging opt-in via SKILL_RUNS_LOG.
YAML loading uses a yaml.SafeLoader-derived UniqueLoader; lexical evaluations report quality NOT ASSESSED rather than treating fixtures as real model scores.
Rejects assertion that publishing zero Twist establishes hardware stopping, calls for independent stop and operator-controlled bounded physical test.
Documentation contains firmware flash commands, so source is not permission to execute against hardware.

hard_holds.reason: 15 bundled Python tools and numerous operational commands; no pinned third-party security scan, dependency resolution or adversarial dynamic tests ran.
Portable and Claude-plugin profiles have different authority and code footprints; hook-enabled configuration was not installed/tested and hooks are only advisory.
Test/launch/flash commands can affect deployed systems if run in the wrong environment; operator execution and physical stopping remain independently required.
Python 3.10+, PyYAML and actual distro/tool versions must be tested on intended client/platform; source documentation is no proof of correct runtime API.
Root Apache-2.0 text verified; extracted ROS example snippets and linked third-party/vendor materials were not individually rights-cleared.
Repository-level Git blob pins and source checks do not demonstrate exact copied bytes, installer rollback, hook behavior, or safe shell execution on host.
